description: This file defines the I18NGroupModel class, which models internationalization (i18n) group data within the OrangeHRM system. It implements normalization via traits and interfaces for API serialization purposes, and constructs itself based on an entity object representing an i18n group.

classes.name: I18NGroupModel
classes.description: A model class for representing internationalization groups in the API, capable of serialization and normalization of the underlying I18NGroup entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an I18NGroup entity and sets up property filters and names.
